ana (security): quick question — ACME's security questionnaire wants proof of KMS key rotation and per-request envelope key usage. We currently offer customer-managed keys; do we have rotation audit logs they can consume or a signed attestation?

mike (sre): short answer: rotation events are logged and exportable. we don't do per-request envelope keys today (no envelope-per-request). for rotation: we log KMS Admin API calls (Create/Update/Destroy) to Cloud Audit Logs and forward to the sec-archive sink.

ana (security): can you paste the log query we usually run so I can include a snippet in the questionnaire?

mike (sre): sure — query we use in Logging UI / api: 
```
resource.type="k8s_cluster" OR resource.type="gce_instance"
protoPayload.serviceName="cloudkms.googleapis.com"
protoPayload.methodName:("CreateCryptoKeyVersion" OR "UpdateCryptoKeyVersion" OR "ScheduleKeyVersionDestruction")
```
that returns actor, timestamp, requestMetadata.remoteIp.

jordan (eng): note: we mirror key metadata to the audit-db nightly (retention 13 months). that can help produce a timeline. we don't provide HSM export or signed attestation for the key material itself.

ciara (sales): acme also asked who can approve key rotation changes. do we have RBAC roles mapped to SSO groups to cite?

ana (security): yes — rotation privileged action is limited to role `roles/redwood.kms_admin` which we map to an Okta group `redwood-kms-admins`. mike, can you export the current group membership csv for the questionnaire?

mike (sre): pulling group membership now. will drop csv to the private share. also flag for the questionnaire: they asked about "audit log integrity/tamper evidence" — our answer should mention log forwarding + immutable sink.

ana (security): agreed. include: "logs are forwarded to an immutable GCS bucket (sec-archive) with object versioning and retention; access restricted to sec-admins and changes to bucket IAM are logged". also mention Cloud Audit Logs retention policy and periodic integrity checks.

sec-bot: incident-34567 scheduled: vendor key rotation test on 2026-01-12 02:00 UTC. link: https://redwood-infra/ops/incidents/34567 :information_source:

jordan (eng): noted — we'll pause relevant deployments during the window.

mike (sre): uploaded membership csv + sample log snippet to the secure share: https://redwood-secure/shares/acme-artifacts (internal link) :thumbsup:

ciara (sales): perfect — i'll include both artifacts when sending the questionnaire. one more item: they want our vuln triage SLA and incident notification timelines. what are we stating?

jordan (eng): vuln triage: 72h for critical, 5 days for high, 14 days for medium per policy doc.

ana (security): for questionnaire we'll state 72h critical / 5d high. also they asked about customer notification for confirmed data exfil. what's our timeline?

mike (sre): confirmed exfil: notify affected customers within 48 hours of confirmation; provide preliminary RCA within 7 days, and a full MTR (mitigation/forensics) report within 30 days.

ana (security): good — i'll draft the answers with those timelines + links to the policy doc and the sec-archive artifact. anyone object to these wordings?

ciara (sales): looks good from my side. satisfied.

jordan (eng): no objections.

ana (security): final action items: mike — export okta group csv & paste sample audit log snippet; jordan — export the nightly audit-db key metadata sample; ciara — prepare artifact bundle for ACME. i'll assemble questionnaire responses and circulate for review by EOD. thanks team :heart:
